Welcome to the Heights

Welcome to Providenca

When we first stood on this hill in 2016, there were only stones, the bora wind, and the view. Over the years, stone by stone and with our own hands, we created this heritage landscape to preserve the memory of Lošinj — an island shaped by its people over centuries.

— The Katalinić Family

Creators and guardians of the Providenca Heritage Landscape

Providenca by Night

Picnic at the Captain's Table

Advance reservation is required for the Picnic experience at Providenca due to limited seating.

Picnic at the Captain's Table

Every table at Providenca bears the name of a Lošinj captain or a sailing ship built on the island — in honour of the island's rich maritime past. Next to each table stands a portrait of the captain or the ship it is named after.

Enjoy a picnic basket full of local flavours — the very ones that Lošinj captains once carried across the Mediterranean. As the sun sets over the sea, every table has its own story.

Gallery

“Captains shared bread and cheese on deck, with a view of the open sea.”

An Evening in Providenca's Heritage Landscape

Why Picnic at Providenca?

A picnic means going somewhere. Stepping away from everyday life, arriving at a place with a view, and pausing.

On Lošinj, this very act of departure has been part of life for centuries. Sailors left the island and returned to it, and between those two moments a story was born that shaped its identity.

That is why the island's flavours are gathered at Providenca in a wicker basket. Just as the sea has intertwined the fates of people, islands and distant lands, so the flavours, stories and heritage of the Mediterranean are woven together in this basket.

A picnic at Providenca is not just a meal. It is part of the island's story.

Providenca by Day

Providenca By Day

At Providenca, the daylight reveals the island's heritage.

01

Self-Guided Tour – Lošinj Island of Captains by Providenca

Explore Providenca at your own pace through six interpretation points that reveal the story of Lošinj — the island of captains. Through nature, heritage, and fascinating stories, you will discover how the sea, people, and landscape have together shaped the identity of the island over centuries. This is not just a walk, but an experience that connects you with Lošinj.

02

Escape Trail Providenca

The storm has passed, the ship has been found, and all crew members have been saved… except one. Join experienced Lošinj captain Aldebrando Petrina in the search for the missing crew member. Using his ship's logbook, follow the clues, solve the puzzles, and discover stories hidden in Lošinj's maritime heritage. Will you succeed in completing the rescue mission before it is too late?

Recommended group size

2-5 players

Duration

30-45 min

Challenge level

medium

Age

Adults and children 10+ accompanied by adults

The activity is recommended for adults and children over 10 years old accompanied by adults.

03

Providenca VR - Panoramic flight over Lošinj

Embark on an exciting virtual journey - a panoramic flight over Lošinj. On the wings of our guide, Captain Bepo, discover hidden corners of the island and hear stories only he knows.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

  • Providenca is a family-created heritage landscape on the hill of Umpiljak above Mali Lošinj. It was established as a private project with the aim of preserving and interpreting the natural, cultural, and maritime heritage of the island of Lošinj through specially designed experiences.

  • The site of today's Providenca was once an inaccessible rocky terrain overgrown with maquis. Since 2016, the Katalinić family has been shaping this space with their own work and resources — clearing the land, restoring and building dry-stone walls, laying out paths, reintroducing native plants, and creating interpretive content that brings the story of Lošinj closer to visitors. The only thing that existed here before Providenca was the view.

  • The view, the rocks, and the sea are part of nature that belongs to everyone. Providenca, however, is a cultural landscape shaped by human hands with respect for nature. What you experience today as a harmonious space is the result of years of work, restoration of dry-stone walls, path maintenance, and carefully designed heritage interpretation.

  • A question we often hear is: "Why do you charge for the view?" The answer is simple — the view is not charged for. The view of the Kvarner bay is still free and accessible to everyone. There are many places around Providenca where you can enjoy the same view at no cost. What you pay for at Providenca is not nature, but the space that has been created and the gastronomic experiences that give this place its identity. Providenca is not funded by public money. It was created and is maintained exclusively through the private investment of the Katalinić family, and every visit contributes to its further preservation and development.

  • Providenca is not a public park or a hospitality venue. It is designed as a heritage landscape experienced through pre-designed experiences. A limited number of visitors ensures that the space remains peaceful, preserved and authentic, and gives every guest a quality experience.

  • All activities take place with a limited number of participants in order to preserve the space, its atmosphere and the quality of interpretation. A reservation ensures that every visitor experiences Providenca exactly as it was intended.

  • Providenca offers several different heritage experiences. Daytime: • Lošinj – Island of Captains – a self-guided interpretive tour through six stations. • Escape Trail Providenca – an interactive quest inspired by the logbook of Captain Aldebrando Petrina. Evening: • Picnic at the Captain's Table – a Gastro & Heritage Experience that combines local gastronomy with stories about Lošinj's captains, sailing ships, and maritime heritage.

  • Providenca is the work of the Katalinić family. It was born from the conviction that heritage is not preserved only through protection, but also by creating places where it can be experienced, understood, and passed on to future generations.

  • Providenca is one of the rare privately funded heritage projects in Croatia. It was created without public investment, solely through the work, knowledge and dedication of one family, who on a former rocky terrain created a space devoted to the preservation and interpretation of the heritage of the island of Lošinj.

  • That is perhaps the best question we can ask. If the answer were no, Providenca would be just a viewpoint. But Providenca was created as a heritage landscape. The sunset is not its purpose, but a gift of nature that completes the experience. What Providenca exists for are the stories of Lošinj, restored dry-stone walls, a landscaped terrain, heritage interpretation, and experiences that connect visitors with the identity of the island.

    The sunset lasts a few minutes. Providenca endures.
